# Platforms Training Academy

> Illinois IDFPR-Approved Security Officer & Concealed Carry (CCL) Training Academy in Chicago, IL. Owned and led by 18-Year U.S. Army Combat Veteran & NRA Certified Law Enforcement Instructor Charles Young (Illinois State License #263-000693, IDFPR Curriculum #102-000398, 225 ILCS 447).

## Key Facts
- **Website:** https://platformstraining.com
- **Phone:** (773) 873-2591
- **Email:** charlesyoung@platformstraining.com
- **Classroom Location:** 200 E 75th St, Chicago, IL 60619
- **Live-Fire Range Location:** Eagle Sports Range, 5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452
- **Credentials:** IDFPR Approved Curriculum #102-000398 (225 ILCS 447), 18-Year Combat Veteran Owned, NRA Certified Law Enforcement Instructor.

## Courses & Pricing
- **[20-Hour Online Unarmed Security Course (PERC Card)](https://platformstraining.com/course/):** $50.00. 100% online, self-paced 24/7, 10 interactive modules + untimed 50-question exam. Immediate IDFPR Certificate of Completion upon passing to apply for your Illinois PERC Card.
- **[28-Hour Online Armed Security Course (Tan Card / FCC)](https://platformstraining.com/armed-course/):** $200.00. 20 hours online 24/7 + 8-hour live-fire range qualification at Eagle Sports Range (ammunition, targets, eye/ear protection, and range fees included).
- **[16-Hour Illinois Concealed Carry Course (Full CCL)](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=ccl):** $200.00. Full Illinois State Police-approved 16-hour concealed carry training (classroom + live-fire range qualification).
- **[8-Hour Illinois Concealed Carry Course (Prior Credit)](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=ccl):** $150.00. For applicants with 8 hours of prior approved firearms credit.
- **[8-Hour Illinois CCL – Military & Law Enforcement](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=ccl):** $125.00. Discounted 8-hour Illinois Concealed Carry course for active/veteran military and law enforcement.
- **[3-Hour Illinois CCL Refresher Course (5-Year Renewal)](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=ccl):** $125.00. Required 3-hour renewal & live-fire qualification for Illinois Concealed Carry License holders.
- **[Security Firearm Requalification (Annual Tan Card Qual)](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=security):** $125.00. Annual IDFPR firearm requalification at Eagle Sports Range.
- **[Security Firearm Upgrade Qualification (Multi-Weapon)](https://platformstraining.com/courses.html?filter=security):** $125.00. Multi-weapon qualification for Illinois armed security officers.
